prompt:
The maps below show the harbour area of the town of Westhaven in 1990 and the same area in 2020.

Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.
instruction_line: You should spend about 20 minutes on this task. Write at least 150 words.

visual.alt: Two side-by-side maps of the harbour area of the town of Westhaven in 1990 and 2020: the fishing harbour has been replaced by a marina, the fish market by restaurants, and the boat repair yard by apartment blocks; the car park and hotel have been enlarged, and a promenade along the shore plus a visitor centre and gardens on the open field have been added.

key_points: Over thirty years the area changes from a working fishing harbour into a leisure- and visitor-focused area — this is the overall pattern
The jetty at sea is kept but pontoons are added beside it; the small fishing harbour is replaced by a marina where more boats are moored
The fish market on the shore stays in the same area but is converted into seafood restaurants; the boat repair yard is demolished and replaced by three apartment blocks
The car park to the northeast of the road is enlarged, and the hotel to the southwest is also extended
There are two new features: a promenade running along the shore, and a visitor centre with gardens that replaces the open field in the southeast
Two features stay unchanged: the coast road dividing the area in two, and the four cottages south of the road
common_mistakes: Not using direction and location language ('to the north of the coast road', 'along the shore', 'opposite the hotel')
Describing the two maps separately without highlighting the change — change is the real focus of this task
Confusing tenses — using the present tense for 1990 and the past tense for 2020
Not mentioning the elements that stay unchanged (the coast road, the cottages) at all
Interpreting or explaining the reason for the change ('this brought more tourists to the town')
